text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality {porneia} among you⁺, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans {ethnesin}: A man has his father’s wife.
And you⁺ are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your⁺ fellowship the man who did this?
Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit {pneumati}, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
When you⁺ are assembled in the name of our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus and I am with you in spirit {pneumatos}, along with the power {dynamei} of the Lord Jesus (YHWH saves),
hand this man over to Satan (the adversary) for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit {pneuma} may be saved on the Day of the Lord [the Lord Jesus].
Your⁺ boasting is not good. Do you⁺ not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?
Get rid of the old leaven, that you⁺ may be a new unleavened batch, as you⁺ really are. For Christ (the Anointed One), our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
Therefore let us keep the feast, not with the old bread, leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth.
I wrote you⁺ in my letter {epistolē} not to associate with sexually immoral people.
I was not including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you⁺ would have to leave this world.

But now I am writing you⁺ not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.
What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you⁺ not to judge those inside?
God {Theos} will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked man from among you⁺ \Expel the evil from among you/.”
